ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity (light-gray/off-white) to low-intensity (black/dark-charcoal) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region extending from the peduncle to the median notch. High-intensity contiguous regions are mapped to the lateral halves of both lobes, containing significant internal low-intensity mottling and micro-scale pixel variance.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees and a narrow vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in vertical amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to the median notch, with convex curvature on the outer distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel, dark-pigmented linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the high-intensity regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both fluke lobes; evidence of irregular trailing edge erosion and minor tip truncation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark-pigmented focal blob located in the lower-interior quadrant of the right lobe's high-intensity zone.
